screens.text: Every Muslim does five big things. They are called the Five Pillars.

picture.alt: An open hand showing five fingers

screens.text: One. I say: there is no god but Allah, and Muhammad is His Messenger.

arabic.text: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ مُحَمَّدٌ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ

screens.text: Two. I pray five times a day.

picture.alt: A boy standing on a prayer mat

screens.text: Three. I give some of my money to people who need it.
Four. In Ramadan, I do not eat or drink from morning until sunset.

picture.alt: The moon in the night sky

screens.text: Five. If I am able, I visit the Kaaba in Makkah once in my life.

picture.alt: The Kaaba in an old desert town
